status: DRAFT for independent review; no value computed

formation.dates: first decision close of each UTC month 2021-03 .. 2025-11 (57)
formation.eligibility: listed at the close (universe_history incl. delisted), >= 90 contiguous completed daily bars ending at the close, 3-day median dollar volume >= 250000 USD, not in the round-1 exclusion map, has an executable open after the close
formation.candidate_set: PRE-FEATURE candidate set per month: listed, >= 90 contiguous completed bars, 3-day median dollar volume >= 250000 USD, not excluded, executable next open. This set is the breadth_ctx denominator and the stratification population; the verified-feature NaN filter is applied AFTER it and counted (R-AG). Note: ret_90 and rs_btc_90 need 91 closes, so a name with exactly 90 bars enters the candidate set and becomes verified-feature-ineligible that month, counted as such.

conventions.bars: completed daily bars only (bar.t + 86400 <= formation close)
conventions.missing: a feature needing k bars with fewer than k available is NaN; NaN handling is frozen per family below; nothing is forward-filled

verified.nan_rule: a candidate with any NaN verified feature at a formation date is verified-feature-ineligible at that date (counted); no imputation; breadth_ctx and strata are computed on the pre-feature candidate set

features.name: dist_hi_365
features.formula: close[-1] / max(close[-365:]) - 1 (uses the bars available if listed < 365 bars; count >= 90 required)

features.name: rv_20
features.formula: std(log returns over last 20 bars) * sqrt(365)

features.name: rv_60
features.formula: std(log returns over last 60 bars) * sqrt(365)

features.name: age_bars
features.formula: number of completed bars since first bar, log1p

features.name: log_dv_90
features.formula: log(mean(dv[-90:])) — also the stratification variable (quintiles within month)

features.name: breadth_ctx
features.formula: share of the month's PRE-FEATURE candidate set with close[-1] > own SMA50 (denominator fixed before any feature NaN filter; market-context, same value for every name)

assumed.source: DeFiLlama historical endpoints backfilled with available_at NULL; usable only under the declared lag
assumed.family_rule: Identity chain, resolved ONCE and frozen in PHASE4-ROUND3-STAGE0-AUDIT.json: Coinbase currency name for the symbol -> the unique CoinGecko coin with the same symbol AND normalised name (none or several -> no family) -> DeFiLlama child-level protocols whose gecko_id is that CoinGecko id, plus every child of a parentProtocol whose gecko_id is that id. Parents are never summed themselves (only child-level /protocols entries), so no parent/child overlap. No symbol-only fallback, no guessing, no remapping after results.
assumed.availability_rule: a family value dated D is usable from the decision close of D+7 AND only for D >= the family's earliest listedAt on DeFiLlama; a family with no listedAt on any member is UNUSABLE (strict default; the alternative floor 2021-10-12 = the date DeFiLlama began stamping listedAt is offered to the reviewer, see Q2)
assumed.nan_rule: per-feature: training-only mean imputation (standardised 0) PLUS a missingness indicator per fundamental feature (fees_growth_30_missing, rev_growth_30_missing, rev_yield_missing, tvl_change_30_missing); has_family retained as an additional indicator, never a replacement; stable_supply_30 missing => the formation month FAILS CLOSED for the assumed pipeline (no imputation of the global series); all means/stds from observed training-month values only

features.name: fees_growth_30
features.formula: sum(fees over the 30 days ending D) / sum(fees over the 30 days ending D-30) - 1

features.name: rev_yield
features.formula: sum(revenue over 30 days ending D) * 12 / market cap at D (market cap = close * circulating supply from DeFiLlama mcap at D; NaN if absent)

features.name: stable_supply_30
features.formula: totalCirculatingUSD[D]/totalCirculatingUSD[D-30]-1 (global market-context series; same for every name)

features.name: fees_growth_30_missing
features.formula: 1 if fees_growth_30 is NaN at D else 0

features.name: has_family
features.formula: 1 if the frozen audit resolves a usable family for the symbol, else 0

excluded.catalysts: no point-in-time source; any reconstruction is hindsight
excluded.market_cap_point_in_time: DeFiLlama mcap history is not stored point-in-time; used only inside rev_yield in the assumed pipeline and NaN when absent
